claim_boundary: Identity of the Linux renderer that produced the frozen v1 raw-RGBA truth anchors. Other renderers may run compatibility checks but may not replace or claim these exact anchors.

provenance.limitation: The published v1 evidence did not retain native canvas binary or standard-font tree digests. Exact admission therefore remains bound to the frozen renderer fingerprint, recorded runtime, and complete frozen output score; future benchmark versions must retain the additional byte-level provenance.
